collector.note: steps run in order against one collector holding pinned_cp_keys

steps.name: retry_with_more
steps.why: seq 0 again byte-identically (a retry after a timeout), seq 1 new with an outcome in the same batch (receipts are stored first), seq 2 forged

steps.name: outcomes_only
steps.why: an outcome for the stored seq 0 receipt, plus a dropped span: still cert + batch_sig_hex

steps.name: outcomes_only_retry
steps.why: the same outcome batch again: byte-identical outcome is duplicate

steps.name: outcome_receipt_unknown
steps.why: outcomes for a receipt never uploaded, for the rejected forged seq 2, and for stored seq 0 under another experiment_id

steps.name: outcome_other_cert
steps.why: an outcome for stored seq 0 under another valid certificate (another workload key)

steps.name: empty_batch
steps.why: nothing to upload: no cert, no batch_sig_hex needed

steps.name: batch_sig_missing
steps.why: receipts and cert but no batch_sig_hex

steps.name: cert_missing
steps.why: an outcomes-only batch signed but without cert

steps.name: batch_sig_wrong_key
steps.why: signed by a key other than the certificate's

steps.name: cert_sig_invalid
steps.why: certificate signature bit flipped (checked before batch_sig_hex)

steps.name: dropped_bad_key
steps.why: a dropped key without the cert_digest prefix
